summary: XPeng Inc. filed a Form 6-K with a notice of board meeting scheduled for August 24, 2026, to consider and approve its second-quarter and interim results for the period ended June 30, 2026, along with publication and an earnings conference call. This is a routine disclosure of financial results timing, not a special-situation event. No transaction, strategic initiative, or material corporate action is announced. The filing includes standard housekeeping items such as board composition and dial-in details for the earnings call. No special-situation category applies; the appropriate classification is None.
